scientific_integrity: The quantitative conclusions follow from a proved autocorrelation formula and a self-contained complete integer-arithmetic enumeration and orbit verifier. Historical priority and independent audit remain unverified.
scientific_limitations: The sharp optimization is over the exact five root-of-unity alphabets of orders 2 through 6 on the seven nontrivial Fourier characters of the eight-point Boolean group; it does not include continuous phases, other supports, or other alphabets.
title: Exact phase-alphabet fourth moments of the seven nontrivial Walsh characters
